digo: Mpira (also Libugu; fruit Kitoria); mpira, libugu (vine); kitoria (fruit)
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005; ICRAF ('Digo: Mpira, Libugu, Kitoria (fruit)'); Mgombato ('libugu a kind of creeper ... mbugu')

teaser.en: The Digo word for rubber, *mpira*, comes from this forest vine, which was once tapped for its sticky white latex.
teaser.sw: Neno la Kidigo la mpira, *mpira*, linatokana na mtambaa huu wa msituni, ambao zamani uligemwa kwa utomvu wake mweupe unaonata.
teaser.dg: Neno *mpira*, ambaro kpwa Chidigo rina mana ya *rubber*, rinalavywa kula mmea hinyu wa tsaka unaokpwera, ambao kare kala unatuluzwa maziyage mereru ganayonyata.

summary.en: *Mpira* is the rubber vine, a strong woody climber of the coastal forest and woodland with round orange fruits. Its sweet-sour fruit is sold in coast towns, and its latex was once tapped for rubber.
summary.sw: *Mpira* ni mtambaa imara wenye shina gumu wa misitu na mapori ya pwani, wenye matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya chungwa (kwa Kiingereza *rubber vine*). Tunda lake tamu-chachu huuzwa katika miji ya pwani, na utomvu wake zamani uligemwa kutengeneza mpira.
summary.dg: *Mpira* ni *rubber vine*, mmea unaokpwera wenye nguvu na nyama za muhi, wa matsaka na weruni wa pwani, wenye matunda ga mviringo ga rangi ya chungbwa. Matundage ga mtswano na ngbwadu nkuguzwa midzi ya pwani, na kare maziyage kala ganatuluzwa kuhenda mpira.

about.en:
*Mpira* is a tough, woody climber that hauls itself into the canopy with coiling tendrils. The leaves are small and arranged in opposite pairs. Break a stem or leaf and a sticky white latex oozes out, the feature that made the plant famous.

The fruits are round and orange, with a hard rind around soft, sweet-sour pulp that clings to the seeds. Like many members of the dogbane family (Apocynaceae), it has fragrant tubular flowers.
about.sw:
*Mpira* ni mtambaa mgumu wenye shina gumu unaojivuta hadi kileleni mwa miti kwa vikonyo vilivyojikunja vya kushikilia. Majani ni madogo na yamepangwa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana. Ukivunja shina au jani, utomvu mweupe unaonata hutiririka, sifa iliyoufanya mmea huu kuwa maarufu.

Matunda ni ya mviringo na ya rangi ya chungwa, yenye ganda gumu linalozunguka nyama laini tamu-chachu inayoshikamana na mbegu. Kama wanafamilia wengi wa familia ya Apocynaceae, una maua yenye harufu nzuri na umbo la mrija.
about.dg:
*Mpira* ni mmea unaokpwera wenye nguvu na nyama za muhi, unaokpwera hadi dzulu kabisa ya mihi kpwa nyuzi zinazolinga-linga. Makodzage ni madide na ganamera mairi-mairi ganayololana. Uchivundza muhi au kodza, kunatuluka maziya mereru ganayonyata, na hicho ndicho chikahenda mmea hinyu umanyikane sana.

Matunda ni ga mviringo na ga rangi ya chungbwa, na gada gumu rinarozunguluka nyama laini ya mtswano na ngbwadu inayogbwirana na tembe. Dza mimea minji ya jamii ya *dogbane* (*Apocynaceae*), una maruwa genye arufu nono, ganayokala dza mrija.

where.en: Look for *mpira* along forest edges and in the *Brachystegia* woodland of the coastal belt, and in the thickets of the kaya forests. In fruit, the orange balls hanging in tangled vines make it easier to find.
where.sw: Mtafute *mpira* kando ya misitu na katika mapori ya *Brachystegia* ya ukanda wa pwani, na katika vichaka vizito vya misitu ya kaya. Wakati wa matunda, mipira ya rangi ya chungwa inayoning'inia katika mitambaa iliyosokotana huufanya kuwa rahisi kuupata.
where.dg: Hendza *mpira* kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye matsaka ga *Brachystegia* ga pwani, na kpwenye vitsaka vya matsaka ga kaya. Uchikala na matunda, matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa dza mipira, ganayobwadzika kahi ya mbugu zirizodzilinga-linga, ganahenda uonekane rahisi.

uses.en:
The fruit is eaten fresh, and its sweet-sour taste makes it a seller's item in coastal towns. The latex was once tapped as rubber and is used as bird-lime, a sticky paste for catching birds.

The leaves and roots are used in medicine.
uses.sw:
Tunda huliwa bichi, na ladha yake tamu-chachu huifanya kuwa bidhaa ya kuuzwa katika miji ya pwani. Utomvu wake zamani uligemwa kama mpira na hutumika kama ulimbo, ute unaonata wa kunasa ndege.

Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg:
Tunda nkuriwa dza ririvyo, na kpwa sababu ya ladhaye ya mtswano na ngbwadu, nkuguzwa midzi ya pwani. Kare maziyage kala ganatuluzwa kuhenda mpira, na nkuhumirwa dza *ukaka*, utomvu unaonyata wa kugbwira nyuni.

Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

culture.en: The name tells the plant's history: *mpira* means rubber, and this vine was once tapped for it.
culture.sw: Jina linasimulia historia ya mmea: *mpira* linamaanisha mpira (*rubber*), na mtambaa huu zamani uligemwa ili kuupata.
culture.dg: Dzina rinaeleza historia ya mmea: *mpira* rina mana ya *rubber*, na kare mmea hinyu kala unatuluzwa maziya kuhenda mpira.

names.en: The Digo names for the vine are *mpira* and *libugu* (plural *mbugu*), and the fruit is *kitoria*. Swahili names include *mpira*, *ulimbo* and *mbungo*. In Giriama it is *mutongazi* or *mtoria*. In English it is rubber vine. Note that Swahili *mbungo* is also used for the related rubber vine *Saba comorensis*.
names.sw: Majina ya Kidigo ya mtambaa ni *mpira* na *libugu* (wingi *mbugu*), na tunda ni *kitoria*. Majina ya Kiswahili ni pamoja na *mpira*, *ulimbo* na *mbungo*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mutongazi* au *mtoria*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *rubber vine*. Ifahamike kuwa *mbungo* ya Kiswahili pia hutumika kwa mtambaa mwingine wa mpira unaohusiana nao, *Saba comorensis*.
names.dg: Madzina ga Chidigo ga mmea hinyu ni *mpira* na *libugu* (unji *mbugu*), na tunda nkuihwa *kitoria*. Madzina ga Chiswahili ni *mpira*, *ulimbo* na *mbungo*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *mutongazi* au *mtoria*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *rubber vine*. Manya kukala kpwa Chiswahili *mbungo* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa *Saba comorensis*, mmea wanjina wa mpira ambao ni nduguye.

reason.en: Related rubber vine with larger orange fruits
reason.sw: Mtambaa wa mpira unaohusiana nao, wenye matunda makubwa zaidi ya rangi ya chungwa
reason.dg: Nduguye, mmea wanjina wa mpira wenye matunda makulu ga rangi ya chungbwa

reason.en: Same family; another wild fruit of the bush
reason.sw: Familia moja; tunda jingine la porini la vichakani
reason.dg: Wa jamii mwenga; tunda ranjina ra tsaka ra weruni

reason.en: Grows in the Brachystegia woodland where this vine climbs
reason.sw: Hukua katika mapori ya Brachystegia ambako mtambaa huu hupanda
reason.dg: Unamera matsaka ga Brachystegia phatu mmea hinyu unaphokpwera

reason.en: Another wild orange-coloured fruit of the coastal woodland
reason.sw: Mkwakwa, tunda jingine la porini la rangi ya chungwa la mapori ya pwani
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina ra tsaka ra rangi ya chungbwa ra matsaka ga pwani

definition.en: The sticky latex of this climber.
definition.dg: Utomvu unaonyata wa mmea hinyu unaokpwera.

use.en: Young people use it to make sticky traps for birds.
use.sw: Vijana huutumia kutengeneza mitego ya kunata ya kunasa ndege.
use.dg: Barobaro nkuuhumira kuhenda mihambo inayonyata ya kugbwira nyuni.
